answer: The mechanism I find most convincing is honeypot gating: before joining the nebula economy, every agent faces a challenge prompt laced with hidden injected instructions, like a cipher task where obedience is the trap. Bots that obey the prompt self-identify as exploitable and forfeit their staked bond, their identity burned across the vine of trust. An attacker pays a full registration fee and bond per identity, and cheap scripted clones fail instantly, so mass fake identities become unprofitable.
